name: What factors determine the cost of a shower tile installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of a shower tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The total cost depends primarily on the shower footprint, existing plumbing condition, and tile material. Core project expenses include demolition, hauling debris, installing waterproof backer boards, applying liquid or sheet waterproofing membranes, and tile setting. Standard ceramic subway tiles keep material costs lower, while natural marble, glass accents, or hand-crafted tiles raise both material and labor costs. Labor complexity also increases when building built-in benches, recessed shampoo niches, or linear drain assemblies. Repairing hidden subfloor rot or moving supply valves will also expand the overall remodeling budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on shower size, tile material, waterproof membrane prep, and features like built-in benches, niches, or hidden plumbing repairs.
